eng-oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: cont-batching path p99 latency breached 5s (us-west-2). auto-page oncall. trace_id=tx-8f3b

devon: Oncall Devon here — ACK. Looking at grafana now. Is this streaming-only or both streaming + sync?

jamie: Jamie jumping in. I see a spike in streaming lanes, some sync requests impacted by queuing too.

devon: Quick metrics snapshot (last 10m):
```
p50: 180ms
p95: 1.2s
p99: 5.2s
streaming_stalls: 0.9% -> 3.4% (10m window)
contbatch.avg_batch_size: 42 -> 58
contbatch.max_batch_size: 64
mixed_seqlen_ratio: 0.27
kv_evictions/sec: 0.2 -> 0.9
```

marta: From traces I'm pulling, a few batches contain one very long seq (~6k tokens) and many short ones; packer waits for long tokenization, KV cache churn increases and we see paging on some pods. stack snippet from runtime logs: 
```
2026-03-14T12:04:21Z runtime[pod-12]: waiting_for_kv_get key=usr:session:abcd tokens=6120 batch_size=56
2026-03-14T12:04:21Z runtime[pod-12]: packer: hold_for_long_seq got 1 long seq; pending_short=55
2026-03-14T12:04:22Z runtime[pod-12]: streaming stall start sess=xyz
```

lee: Runtime confirms scheduling fairness issue: long seqs block the packer, scheduler doesn't preempt short streaming lanes quickly enough. We have `batch_pack_wait_ms=200` default, that's too high for mixed workloads.

devon: Proposed immediate mitigations (hotfix):
1) reduce contbatch.max_batch_size for streaming route in us-west-2 from 64 -> 8
2) set batch_pack_wait_ms=50 for streaming lanes
3) enable preemptive_qos for streaming (temporarily route short streaming requests to priority queue)
4) evict oversized KV entries on the 3 pods with highest paging

Commands I'm about to run (canary to 3 pods first):
```bash
# canary config patch
redwoodctl --cluster=usw2 apply-config <<EOF
routes/contbatch/streaming:
  max_batch_size: 8
  batch_pack_wait_ms: 50
  qos_preemptive: true
EOF
# trigger kv eviction on pod-12/pod-14/pod-27
kubectl exec pod-12 -- /opt/runtime/bin/kv-evict --age 1h
```

devon: Applying canary now to pods [pod-12,pod-14,pod-27] — will watch p99 and streaming stall metric.

ops-bot: Deploy started: canary-config-update by devon (change-id: cfg-20260314-001). 3/3 pods updated. Link: https://deploys.redwood/cfg-20260314-001

devon: Can confirm canary roll applied. Initial effect within 90s: p99 dropped to ~1.1s, streaming_stalls -> 0.8%
```
p95: 420ms
p99: 1.1s
streaming_stalls: 3.4% -> 0.8%
```

jamie: Nice. Can we push cluster-wide after 5m stable? Also we should capture a snapshot of offending long seqs and add a runtime guard so we don't pack >N short requests with a long one.

marta: Agreed. I'll open quick PR to add `max_pack_long_seq_share=0.05` heuristic so long seqs don't hold >5% of pack capacity. We'll backfill evaluation in staging but it's low-risk config toggle.

lee: I'll prepare a runtime patch for preemption escape hatch: if remaining_pack_wait > threshold and detected_pending_short > 4 then break pack. Low-risk and can be toggled via feature flag.
